reader.requirement: At --std 85 a program that opens a report file (OUTPUT or EXTEND, including the OPEN that creates an absent OPTIONAL file) before INITIATE must get a working report run on that open file. The rule is a constraint on the program, so an INITIATE with the file not open is outside the standard (GR2), and the 1985 text gives that case no defined outcome.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (the OPEN half: no Table 19 arbitration at 85)

reader.edition-search: Read ReportWriter.Initiate: it has no DialectBehaviors.IsActive call and no Edition read. It tests CobolFile.OpenModeIfOpen and, when the file is not open in output or extend mode, calls ReportFileModeError, which raises nothing while checking is off, and takes no action on the report. The only edition read on the path is in the OPEN arbitration.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf37_04 covers OPEN OUTPUT and then OPEN EXTEND before each INITIATE. It does not cover OPEN EXTEND of an absent OPTIONAL report file before INITIATE, or the violating order

probes.printed: OUTPUT LC=1 / EXTEND LC=1 / TAGS 02 AB  EXPECT: MATCH
OPEN EXTEND RP 05 / RP LC=2 / RQ LC=1 / AFTER BAD INITIATE
probes.expected: the absent OPTIONAL file is created by OPEN EXTEND (05) and the report runs on it (two details: LINE-COUNTER 2); OPEN OUTPUT then INITIATE works; an INITIATE after CLOSE has no outcome the standard defines (GR2), and the run is not corrupted

reader.notes: Nothing opens a report file implicitly. INITIATE reads the connector's actual open mode (OpenModeIfOpen) and does nothing to the report when the file is not open, which is a safe outcome for a case 1985 leaves undefined. The legal orders, including the OPTIONAL-file creation, produce correct report runs.

refuter.evidence: r3two.cob (runs/r3two-001, --std 85): one file holding two reports (REPORTS ARE PA PB), one OPEN OUTPUT, INITIATE PA PB: 'PA LC 02 / PB LC 01', file 'PA PB PA'; then CLOSE, OPEN EXTEND (00), INITIATE PB appends 'PB' (file 'PA PB PA PB'). After a FAILED OPEN EXTEND of an absent non-OPTIONAL report file (35), INITIATE and GENERATE ran without corrupting the run ('AFTER GENERATE ON UNOPENED 35'), an outcome 1985 leaves undefined (XIII.4.5.4 GR2). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR3 ... the text is in GR3'. GR3 is a constraint on the program; every legal order works.
